hub.releaseNotes: macOS focus fix, auth state buffering.

freecell.releaseNotes:
- Steam players: you now have an account the moment the game opens, signed in through Steam, with nothing to fill in. Add an email in Settings > Account to play as yourself on your phone or another PC. Deleting the account shows exactly what it removes before you confirm.
- Long columns pack their cards to stay on the board instead of running off the bottom; replays are unchanged.
- Group and Arena: a round that starts while you watch a replay now takes the board cleanly, a seat quiet for 90 seconds shows Away, and the lobby clock can no longer be skewed by a stale cached response.
- Fixes: auto-moves no longer stall after Restart, the gold best-move arc on Easy points at the right card, the foundation callout says how to send a card up for your input, help offers stay off Hardcore, the bell has Mark all read, and the Group Play panel sits below the status bar.
- Under the hood: a newer Electron (no more black windows on some PCs), every Windows file signed.

minesweeper.releaseNotes: Shared fixes with MSO FreeCell Arena 1.4.49: a newer Electron (no more black windows on some PCs), every Windows file signed, Mark all read in the bell, account deletion shows what it removes.
